# Storyblocks

> > Storyblocks is a comprehensive royalty-free stock media subscription platform offering unlimited downloads of videos, templates, audio, and images for creative professionals.

Storyblocks provides creators with access to millions of royalty-free assets including stock footage, motion graphics templates, sound effects, and images. The platform integrates directly with major video editing software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and Apple Motion, enabling seamless workflows for video editors, motion designers, and content creators.

## Key Topics

- Royalty-free licensing
- Stock footage
- Video templates
- Motion graphics
- After Effects templates
- Premiere Pro templates
- DaVinci Resolve templates
- Apple Motion templates
- 4K/8K video
- Stock images
- Vector graphics
- Sound effects
- Unlimited downloads
- Adobe Creative Cloud integration
- Diverse creators

## Subscription & Pricing

- [Stock Media Subscription Plans and Pricing](https://www.storyblocks.com/pricing): Flexible subscription tiers offering unlimited downloads of all stock media with monthly and annual billing options
- [Storyblocks Homepage](https://www.storyblocks.com): Main platform offering unlimited stock downloads with flexible licensing for videos, templates, audio, and images

## Video Templates & Editing Software

- [Over 20,000 Customizable Video Editing Templates](https://www.storyblocks.com/video/templates): Comprehensive collection of 20,000+ customizable video templates compatible with major editing software
- [Royalty-Free After Effects Templates](https://www.storyblocks.com/templates/after-effects-templates): 13,000+ royalty-free After Effects templates for motion graphics, transitions, and visual effects
- [Royalty-Free Premiere Pro Templates](https://www.storyblocks.com/templates/premiere-pro-templates): 10,000+ Premiere Pro templates including transitions, logos, titles, and effects for video editing
- [Royalty-Free DaVinci Resolve Templates](https://www.storyblocks.com/templates/davinci-resolve-templates): 2,900+ DaVinci Resolve templates featuring cinematic transitions, openers, and color grading effects
- [Royalty-Free Apple Motion Templates](https://www.storyblocks.com/templates/apple-motion-templates): 4,000+ Apple Motion templates including glitch transitions, title animations, and motion effects

## Stock Video & Motion Graphics

- [4K Stock Animated Backgrounds](https://www.storyblocks.com/video/motion-backgrounds): 110,000+ 4K and HD animated motion backgrounds for professional video projects and visual effects
- [Re: Stock: Authentic Footage Celebrating Human Stories](https://www.storyblocks.com/diverse-stock-footage): Curated collection of authentic stock footage by diverse creators celebrating inclusive human stories

## Stock Images & Graphics

- [Download Unlimited Stock Images, Vectors, and Stock Graphics](https://www.storyblocks.com/images): Unlimited royalty-free stock images, vectors, and graphics with flexible licensing for all creative projects
- [Stock Photos and Royalty-Free Images](https://www.storyblocks.com/images/photos): Extensive stock photo library with unlimited downloads for active subscribers
- [Stock Vector Graphics, Royalty-Free Vector Art](https://www.storyblocks.com/images/vectors): Professional vector graphics and royalty-free vector art for design and branding projects
- [Stock Illustrations, Royalty-Free Images & Vectors](https://www.storyblocks.com/images/illustrations): Diverse collection of stock illustrations and royalty-free artwork for creative applications

## Audio & Sound Design

- [Search for Sound Effects](https://www.storyblocks.com/audio/sound-effects): Royalty-free sound effects library with advanced keyword search and filtering capabilities

## Integration & Tools

- [Storyblocks Plugin for Adobe Premiere Pro & After Effects](https://www.storyblocks.com/adobe-creative-cloud-plugin): Native plugins enabling seamless integration with Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects workflows
